_comment: Hand-verified flood tiers for pipeline validation (see docs/methodology.md). Tiers reflect FEMA NFHL data confirmed via the live pipeline. The offline test asserts each recorded zone classifies to the recorded tier; the opt-in integration test (RUN_GOLDEN=1) geocodes each address live and asserts the pipeline reproduces the tier. 'zone_observed' is the FEMA zone seen at verification time and is reference/consistency data — assertions key on the tier, which is stable across minor FEMA remapping.
